images.alt: A highly detailed satellite map view of an industrial sector at night, rendered in a dark mode UI aesthetic. The map uses deep navy and slate gray tones, with stark white outlines for roads and building footprints. A glowing red pulse indicator marks the center of a large containment facility, signaling a critical incident. The overall mood is tense, technological, and strictly utilitarian.
